sentences.japanese: もっと成績を気にかけられればいいのだけれど、でも自分の人生のある点において成績はそんなに重要ではないと分かったんだ。
sentences.english: I wish I could care more about my grades but it seems that, at a certain point of my life, I decided they wouldn't be so important anymore.

sentences.japanese: 君はよく勉強すれば良い点をとれるだろうが。
sentences.english: If you studied hard, you would get good marks.

sentences.japanese: 君の行動には遺憾な点が多い。
sentences.english: Your behavior leaves much to be desired.

sentences.japanese: 君が経験不足である点を考えてあげます。
sentences.english: I'll make allowances for your lack of experience.

sentences.japanese: 君がもらう給料の点からこれはいい仕事かね。
